option_relations.rationale: Giant bullous emphysema is a severe form of emphysema, which is a component of COPD. While not directly equivalent, it falls under the broader umbrella of COPD.
Drug-induced bullous emphysema is a specific etiology leading to bullous emphysema, which is a component of COPD. Therefore, it is a supertype of the general COPD leaf.

Substance-induced bullous emphysema (tobacco and methamphetamine) describes a specific etiology of bullous emphysema, which is a component of COPD. Therefore, it is a supertype of the general COPD leaf.
Heroin-induced bullous emphysema is a specific etiology leading to bullous emphysema, which is a component of COPD. Therefore, it is a supertype of the general COPD leaf.
